units.source_text: [\[6\]](#part1331.html#w6) 临时祭是节日之一，或称贺茂临时祭，

en.t: The Extraordinary Festival was one of the seasonal festivals, also called the Kamo Extraordinary Festival,

units.source_text: 于十一月内第二个酉日举行，前几天预先演习音乐。

en.t: and was held on the second Day of the Rooster in the eleventh month, with the music rehearsed several days beforehand.
